product_one_liner.value: WindBorne operates autonomous, long-duration weather balloons to collect global atmospheric observations and combines those data with AI forecasts for individual and enterprise users, including government, research, and commercial organizations.
product_one_liner.notes: Homepage and platform pages describe its balloon observation network and AI forecasting offering.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage offers contact/sales pathways but no public pricing link or pricing page.

named_customers.notes: The company site/FAQ discusses types of users and partners but does not name two customers; government and research partnerships mentioned are not treated as customers.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 103 employees, which falls in the 101-200 band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies Redwood City, California as headquarters; contact page says Redwood Shores, California.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index lists multiple build/engineering posts, including technical WeatherMesh posts and balloon communications/hardware/software engineering content.

public_docs.notes: Public API portal includes multiple documentation sections and articles, including authentication, SDKs, models, forecasts, and endpoints.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live role list provided lists manufacturing, sensor data engineering, launch/operations, and other roles, but no AI/ML/data-science-titled position.

model_provider.value: WindBorne's in-house WeatherMesh AI weather-forecasting models; public documentation does not identify an external AI model provider.
model_provider.notes: The model FAQ identifies its own WeatherMesh and MetaMesh systems, rather than an outside LLM/provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Reviewed legal and FAQ material identifies no SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS certification. FAA/ICAO rule compliance mentioned in the FAQ is regulatory compliance, not one of the requested certifications.

last_funding.notes: The company announced a $37 million Series B on August 5, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 2026 Series B falls within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Current open role titles do not include SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The company announced WindBorne Weather Events on October 29, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Leadership page lists current founders and leadership but no start dates; no dated join/leave evidence was verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The live job listings and public API documentation reviewed do not name CRM or sales/marketing systems.
